rules.default_fall: LRM2.4 §4.5.8 p72; Cadence21.1 Jan2022 p184: only positive rise specified => both rise/fall
rules.linear: LRM p72/Cadence p183: piecewise linear waveform; rise/fall denote complete transition duration
rules.interruption: LRM p73; Cadence p185–186: preserve current value; same direction retain first origin, reverse use old destination; compute new slope for full duration between origin/new target
rules.fall_reflection: Cadence p186 explicitly states equivalent falling behavior

authority: local full manual/LRM read; no remote doc lookup or simulator call
